title: Add a slugify helper to text_utils
description: The module app/text_utils.py is missing a slugify function. Add it so the existing test suite passes. slugify must lowercase the input, replace any run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and strip leading/trailing hyphens.
acceptanceCriteria: app/text_utils.py defines a function slugify(value: str) -> str
brief: A small Python text utility library.
